rationale: The pain is real but narrow and episodic: site owners encounter 5xx-related crawl issues infrequently, and existing tools (GSC crawl stats, server log analysis via Screaming Frog/Sitebulb, and Cloudflare analytics) already address this workflow with moderate effort. Evidence is extremely thin — a single author's two posts — and no distinct willingness-to-pay signal exists beyond the general pattern that SEO agencies buy tools. The minimum bar of 5 distinct pain quotes and at least 1 explicit WTP signal is not met.
